get.description: Lists the Team's Memberships for a signed-in Member (no Device needed). Owners and admins also get roles, timestamps, pending and removed Memberships, and pending invitations. githubLogin is the login the Member last signed in with (null until recorded): display data that may be stale, never an identity.

post.description: An active owner or admin withdraws a pending Membership Invitation of the Team. A revoked invitation can no longer be accepted.

post.description: The User a pending Membership Invitation addresses turns it down. Needs a session, not a Device; an invitation addressed to someone else answers 404.

An owner or admin links a GitHub Repository to a new Project in the Team, with its first Environment. environmentLabel names that Environment (same rules as creating one; default `default`). A Repository that already has an active Project returns it with its first active Environment and ignores the label.

get.description: Lists the Project's Environments for an active Member, oldest first. currentHeadAuthoredAtMs is the head Revision's authored-at instant (null without a Revision); a Project rotation floors its signing time on the latest one.

post.description: The signed-in User ends their own Membership (ADR 0019). A User with an active Device proves one (401 device_proof_required otherwise); a User without one needs a sign-in from the last ten minutes (403 recent_sign_in_required) (ADR 0024). An active Membership owes each Project a rotation. The Team's last active owner, or its only Member, answers 409 owner_transfer_required.

Required while the signed-in User has an active Device (401 device_proof_required without it); a User without one sends none and needs a sign-in from the last ten minutes instead (ADR 0024).

post.description: An active owner deletes the Team (ADR 0019). The body's confirmName must equal the Team name. Every Membership ends at once; retention purges the Team's data after purgeAfter.

get.description: What deleting the signed-in User's account would do: blockingTeams (last active owner with other Members), teamsDeleted (only Member), and teamsLeft.

post.description: Deletes the signed-in User's account (ADRs 0018, 0024); confirmUserId must equal the User id. While the User has an active Device, the request proves one and signature is that Device's base64 Ed25519 signature over the UTF-8 JSON command {"action":"account.delete","userId":<confirmUserId>,"operationId":<Idempotency-Key>} (400 invalid_crypto_object when it does not verify). A User without an active Device sends no signature and needs a sign-in from the last ten minutes (403 recent_sign_in_required). Ends every session of the User.
